text:
Radioactive iodine-131 emits β-particles and has a half-life of 8 days. It decays to produce
xenon-131.
Which statement about this decay is correct?
After 8 days no more β-particles are emitted.
A
B
After 8 days the number of xenon-131 atoms has halved.
C
After 16 days the iodine-131 has decayed completely.
D
After 16 days the number of iodine-131 atoms has reduced to one quarter.

options.label: A
options.text: After 8 days no more β-particles are emitted.

options.label: B
options.text: After 8 days the number of xenon-131 atoms has halved.

options.label: C
options.text: After 16 days the iodine-131 has decayed completely.

options.label: D
options.text: After 16 days the number of iodine-131 atoms has reduced to one quarter.
